requirementname: Initialize and Reset Game Controller The system shall initialize and reset the game controller with various components. Initialize game controller Reset game state The game controller should be initialized with a game, notation, engine, board, and timer. The game state should be reset to stopped when the game controller is reset.

Get and Set Piece Positions The system shall allow retrieval and setting of chess pieces on specific board positions. Retrieve piece at a given position Set a piece at a given position The system must return null if the square is empty. Setting a piece to an existing one should overwrite it. Setting a piece to null should clear the square.

Display Chess Board The system shall display a chess board with all pieces in their initial positions. Render chess board Initialize piece positions The board should be displayed as an 8x8 grid. Each square on the board should alternate between light and dark colors. All standard chess pieces should be present in their initial positions.

Convert User Input to Game Actions The system shall interpret user input (such as a move) and convert it into an appropriate game action. Interpret user moves Handle special moves like castling The system correctly identifies standard moves and updates the game state accordingly. The system properly handles and converts castling moves.

Update Status Display The system shall update the status display based on the chess engine's status. Display engine status React to engine state changes When the chess engine's status changes, the system updates the status display accordingly. The status display is updated using the engine's status display string.

Computer Move Execution The system shall allow the computer to make a move during the game. Allow the computer to calculate and execute its move Display feedback if no valid move can be made When the method `computerPly` is called, it should compute the best move for the computer player. If a valid move cannot be computed, the system shall display an appropriate message. The move calculated by the engine should be executed on the game board.

Computer Move Execution The system shall allow the computer to make a move during the game. Allow the computer to calculate and execute its move Display a message if no valid move is returned by the engine When the method `computerPly` is called, it should compute the best move using the chess engine. If the engine returns a null value, the system shall display 'No computer move returned' and return false. Upon successful computation of a move, the system shall execute the move by calling `doPly` and start the permanent brain process.

Set Player Names Allow the user to change the names of the players in the game. Enable player name modification Update display with new player names The system should allow users to input new names for both white and black players. After a player's name is changed, the corresponding button label on the NotationPanel should be updated accordingly.
